assets.prompt: Edit this approved portrait mobile game home screen into a clean background-only production plate, same tall aspect ratio. Preserve the beautiful bright tropical harbor, cyan sea, blue sky, white clouds, distant sailboats, upper-right lighthouse, wooden harbor edges, foreground dock/plants/starfish. REMOVE every single UI element, label, button, coin, gear, and the entire big central tugboat and its contact wake. Fill removed regions naturally with matching uninterrupted sky and clear calm turquoise water. The center 60 percent of the image must have calm lower-contrast sea with gentle water texture to hold a separate real-time 3D boat. No large foreground boat, no lettering, no logo, no symbols, no controls. Preserve polished bright toy-like 3D illustration quality and composition; this is a background plate for Unity, NOT a mockup. Keep the horizon around 27 percent from top and open water throughout the central and lower-middle region. Portrait 9:19.5.
